input.quote: Array shall not require Ono to place orders directly with a Subcontractor if such Subcontractor is unwilling to fulfill such orders on terms as favorable to Ono as the terms such Subcontractors have extended to Array.
input.rationale: We searched the Agreement for most-favoured-nation, best-terms, price-parity and right-to-match mechanics ("favorable", "no less favorable", "first refusal/negotiation", third-party terms comparisons) and found no obligation requiring Ono to extend Array terms as good as those given to any third party. The only two favourability provisions run in our favour or are neutral: p0502 requires Array's Subcontractors to supply Ono on terms as favourable as those extended to Array, and p0476 is a mutual tax-cooperation provision to secure the most favourable withholding rate. This satisfies the preferred position (no MFN obligation on Customer; Vendor-granted favourable terms are welcome), so no redline is proposed.

mappings.element: Customer has no most-favoured-nation obligation benefiting Vendor.
mappings.quote: Array shall not require Ono to place orders directly with a Subcontractor if such Subcontractor is unwilling to fulfill such orders on terms as favorable to Ono as the terms such Subcontractors have extended to Array.
